lines: Take names, the Pick button and rank badges are medium weight now, not semibold.
Send to agent, Pick and the other main buttons are a blue tint now, never white.
Atelier works with any coding agent: Claude Code by default, or ATELIER_AGENT=gemini, codex, or your own. The button is Send to agent now.
The critic's top take is a faint blue tint now, not a blue ring.
A refresh opens the newest version of what you were looking at. Comparing keeps your older picks.
Screens stay centred: a sideways scroll on the wallpaper no longer nudges them, and a refresh always lands centred.
A note on a design that frames a live page now keeps a real picture of the page, not an empty frame.
Pause stops everything, mid-step too. In note mode the wheel scrolls the design, ⌥ lets you use it, and notes land on the element in a live page, not on its frame.
Notes are the only way to ask now. `/try 3` in a note gives three takes on just that part.
Taste learns from each design's whole run, first version to latest. Re-read all in the Taste tab.
Colour picker, dropdowns and folding groups in the Design tab.
⌥N pins a note on Atelier itself, for Claude to fix.
Takes waiting for a pick show on the vault's Today, under Needs you.
Type `atelier` in any terminal: opens it, and starts it if it isn't running.
